title: Projection commit seam on the event transaction
description: Task B2 of the Task-B sub-split (architect-d89636d1; Task B's honest file map was 13-14 vs the 10 cap, so the field threading and the seam are separated along the interface axis — each is one self-contained deliverable). Objective: expose a commit seam that runs a caller-supplied apply inside the same transaction as the event append. Deliverable, using the residual-verified mechanics (do not rediscover): a NEW commitWithApply method on the event-transaction core class (EventTransactionStore in event-ledger-transaction.ts) — a new inherited method needs NO decision-ledger.ts edit and NO change to the existing one-arg commit signature; the apply callback runs on the COMMITTED-disposition branch immediately after writeCommitEffects (replay returns through the same single COMMIT in event-ledger-recovery.ts and naturally skips the seam); apply context = { database (same open transaction), stored commit summary WITHOUT positions } — do NOT change the writeCommitEffects signature or StoredCommitResult (positions ripple through the shared decision-ledger contract; the callback can SELECT positions by command_id inside the still-open transaction); apply failures are wrapped AT THE INVOCATION SITE as DurableStoreError PROJECTION_APPLY_FAILED (event-ledger-recovery.ts rethrows DurableStoreError unchanged but renames anything else to STORE_UNAVAILABLE via normalizeOperationalError); PROJECTION_APPLY_FAILED joins the closed DurableStoreErrorCode union in store-contracts.ts (insert in ASCII order between OUTCOME_UNKNOWN and PROJECT_SCOPE_MISMATCH; message format `${code}: ${message}`; zero external DurableStoreErrorCode consumers exist so no exhaustive switch breaks); a failing apply rolls back the event append with the handle NOT poisoned (commitAttempted=false + successful ROLLBACK skips poison — verified recovery.ts:16-41); SqliteEventStore gains one delegating method over #core. NOT in scope: the projection fold, relay, subscriptions, upcasters, or any domainSchemaVersion work (Task B1). Hard dependency: StoredEvent domain schema version (Task B1, task-a602b3d4) SHOULD land first to avoid store-contracts.ts contention, but the only shared file is store-contracts.ts and the edits are disjoint (error-code union vs field/constant). Owned paths: packages/store/src/event-ledger-transaction.ts, packages/store/src/sqlite-event-store.ts, packages/store/src/store-contracts.ts (error-code union entry ONLY), and one new seam test. Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/store typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/store test.
definitionOfDone: commitWithApply runs a caller-supplied apply inside the same BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction as the event append, on the COMMITTED disposition only; replayed commits never invoke it.
A throwing apply rolls back the entire event append (event absent, aggregate head unchanged, receipt absent) with PROJECTION_APPLY_FAILED surfaced and the store handle NOT quarantined.
PROJECTION_APPLY_FAILED is a member of the closed DurableStoreErrorCode union with the standard message format; the union stays closed and no other error semantics change.
Existing tests pass unchanged; the focused store typecheck and test command exits 0 with only owned paths committed.
taskRails: Build the seam, not the feature: no projection fold, relay, subscription, or upcaster logic.
Do not change the existing commit signature, writeCommitEffects signature, or StoredCommitResult shape.
A failed apply must roll back the append; partial writes are never acceptable; the rollback must not poison the handle.
Use TDD; keep sources <=250 target/400 hard; commit by explicit pathspec only.

implementationPlan.description: TDD red — new packages/store/src/store-projection-seam.test.ts (<=250). Cases: (1) HAPPY PATH: commitWithApply(input, apply) with a succeeding apply — apply observes the SAME open transaction (insert a row into the projections table inside apply, then after commit both the event AND the projection row are durable; reopening the store sees both); apply receives {database, commit summary} where the summary carries commandId/aggregateId/eventIds (NO positions — the callback SELECTs positions by command_id in-transaction when needed; assert that works); (2) ROLLBACK: a THROWING apply rolls back the ENTIRE append — event absent, aggregate head unchanged (assertAggregateTail baseline), receipt absent, projection row absent — and surfaces DurableStoreError PROJECTION_APPLY_FAILED with the original failure message preserved in `${code}: ${message}` format; (3) NO POISON: after the rollback, the SAME store handle accepts a subsequent plain commit successfully (commitAttempted=false + clean ROLLBACK skips quarantine — verified recovery.ts:16-41); (4) REPLAY SKIP: replaying the same commandId+bytes returns REPLAYED and the apply callback is NEVER invoked (call-recording apply; replay flows through the same single COMMIT — the COMMITTED-disposition gate is the skip mechanism); (5) NON-DurableStoreError apply failures are wrapped AT THE INVOCATION SITE (a plain Error thrown in apply surfaces as PROJECTION_APPLY_FAILED, NOT STORE_UNAVAILABLE — the normalizeOperationalError rename is the trap being tested); (6) plain commit() unchanged — signature and behavior identical, zero interaction with the seam. Confirm RED.
implementationPlan.note:
RED confirmed. `npx vitest run --root . packages/store/src/store-projection-seam.test.ts` -> "Test Files 1 failed (1) / Tests 6 failed (6)". Every failure is the missing seam, not a typo: 5 cases die on `TypeError: store.commitWithApply is not a function` and case 6 on `Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'length')` at `SqliteEventStore.prototype.commitWithApply.length`.

219 lines, all 6 planned cases, mutation-resistant assertions (exact values, no truthiness):
1. same-transaction happy path on a DURABLE store (mkdtemp + openForProject): apply SELECTs global_position by command_id from the still-open transaction (expects [1]) and INSERTs a real row into the projections table; after close+reopen both the event and the projection row are durable. Summary shape pinned by exact sorted key list, so a later attempt to add positions to it fails the test.
2. rollback: apply writes a projections row and THEN throws — event absent, aggregate version back to 0, receipt null, AND the projections row absent (partial-write hunt folded in here rather than deferred to step-4).
3. no poison: same handle after a failed apply accepts a plain commit (COMMITTED, currentVersion 1) and getHealth().quickCheck stays "ok".
4. replay skip: call-recording apply; second identical commitWithApply returns REPLAYED with applyCalls still ["cmd-1"].
5. the STORE_UNAVAILABLE rename trap: a plain Error must surface as code PROJECTION_APPLY_FAILED with message exactly "PROJECTION_APPLY_FAILED: not a DurableStoreError".
6. plain commit unchanged: arity pin `commit.length === 1` (and `commitWithApply.length === 2`) plus unchanged COMMITTED/REPLAYED behaviour.

No fold/relay/subscription/upcaster abstraction anywhere — the test writes a raw projections row through the seam, per the seam-not-feature rail.

ADVERSARIAL REVIEW — 2 REAL DEFECTS FOUND IN MY OWN DIFF, both fixed with tests before commit:
1. ASYNC APPLY SILENTLY COMMITTED BEHIND UNFINISHED WORK. `CommitApply` returns void, and TypeScript's void-return rule accepts an `async` callback without complaint. The seam would have invoked it, ignored the pending promise, COMMITted, and returned success while the caller's projection work had not run — the exact partial-write class this task exists to prevent, with no error anywhere. Fixed: `isThenable(returned)` check after the call throws PROJECTION_APPLY_FAILED ("the commit apply must be synchronous; this transaction cannot await a thenable"), so the append rolls back. Test pins the message and asserts event/receipt/version all absent.
2. UNDESCRIBABLE THROW VALUES DEFEATED THE STABLE CODE. My first wrap used `String(error)`, which itself THROWS for a Symbol or a null-prototype object. That TypeError would escape the catch block, reach withCommandTransaction as a non-DurableStoreError, and get renamed STORE_UNAVAILABLE by normalizeOperationalError — i.e. the precise trap the task flagged, reintroduced through the error formatter. Fixed: total `describeApplyFailure` helper with its own try/catch fallback. Test throws a Symbol and pins PROJECTION_APPLY_FAILED.
Also added: conflict-path coverage (a call-recording apply stays at zero invocations across COMMAND_ID_CONFLICT and EXPECTED_VERSION_CONFLICT), proving the seam runs on no non-COMMITTED exit rather than only on the REPLAYED one.
Considered and rejected as out of scope: an apply that runs its own COMMIT/ROLLBACK. It already fails closed — the outer COMMIT then throws with commitAttempted=true and !isTransaction, which is exactly the poison + OUTCOME_UNKNOWN branch. Documented as a contract in the CommitApply doc comment rather than policed at runtime.

PLANNED CHECKS: (a) partial-write hunt — covered by the rollback test, which writes a projections row and then throws; the row is absent afterwards on a durable reopen. (b) seam-bypass — `git diff 273f417 -- event-ledger-transaction.ts` shows the commit body moved into runCommandTransaction as unchanged context lines; the only in-body delta is the extra resolveCommand argument, and commit() is `runCommandTransaction(rawInput, null)`. Arity pinned by test. (c) replay + conflict recorders both at zero. (d) grep for fold|subscribe|subscription|relay|upcast across all five paths: only hit is a pre-existing B1 doc comment in store-contracts.ts, none in my hunks. (e) store-contracts.ts: exactly 1 changed line, ASCII-correct slot. (f) no scratch files under my paths.
